_comment: Town Wayfarers who trade once with the player (TradeBond, Overworld action bond_trade, 1.3.2). Their trade counts as a bond with a new Wayfarer, so lines with a bond path can unfurl offline too.

lines: Ferrywoman Oona: Some Spirlings only unfurl when they bond with a new Wayfarer. A ferry teaches you that.
Ferrywoman Oona: Trade me one of yours. I'll trade it straight back, and it will have known two of us.
Ferrywoman Oona: One trade is all I keep in me. For the next one, find a friend who travels.
Courier Pell: I carry letters and, now and then, a Spirling. Some of them come back changed.
Courier Pell: A new Wayfarer's hand does that. Trade with me once and I'll hand yours right back.
Courier Pell: My route is full. Trade with your friends now, they carry farther than I do.
Smith Hesketh: A blade changes in the quench. Some Spirlings change when they change hands.
Smith Hesketh: Hand me one, and I'll hand it back. One trade, then I go back to my anvil.
Smith Hesketh: We traded once. The anvil is waiting, and so are your friends.
Boatwoman Mabry: In Hookwick every boat has two owners. Some Spirlings like that too.
Boatwoman Mabry: Let me own yours for a moment, then it's yours again. Once, mind you.
Boatwoman Mabry: Two owners is plenty. Three is a quarrel. Trade with your friends now.
